question: Should maintainers accept the current signed-app idle profiling proof for this macOS idle-wakeup fix, or require one connected-state node-registration refresh sample before merge?
rationale: The source path covers the intended refresh triggers, but replacing fallback polling leaves one live connected-state behavior that was not directly observed.

options.title: Land With Current Proof
options.body: Accept the disclosed proof gap because source inspection covers the refresh triggers and the signed-app profiling evidence supports the idle-wakeup fix.

options.title: Request Connected Refresh Proof
options.body: Ask for one signed-app run against a healthy Gateway showing registration refresh after a config, preference, or permission change without restoring one-second polling.

options.title: Pause For A Specific Missing Trigger
options.body: Hold the PR only if review identifies a concrete node-registration input that no longer refreshes after polling is removed.

recommendation.title: Land With Current Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the disclosed proof gap because source inspection covers the refresh triggers and the signed-app profiling evidence supports the idle-wakeup fix.
